title: Flight schedule change notice
description: Notify travelers about a flight time change on WhatsApp with old and new times. Utility template for airlines and travel agents.
notes: Be exact about the new time and offer a way to rebook. Never mix promotions into disruption notices.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, the schedule for flight *{{flight}}* to {{destination}} has changed. New departure: {{new_time}} (was {{old_time}}). Please check the details and contact us if the new time does not work.
